name: @workspace/tool-logic-code-format
description: The Code Formatter tool's logic (D14, docs/tools/specs/code-format.md): the languages and their Prettier modules, the options, recognising a language in pasted text, Prettier's errors mapped to their place and the XML printer. No library at run time: Prettier and saxes are handed in by the tool's worker (the tests load them in Node). Pure TypeScript: no React, no DOM, no chrome.
